login.heading: Sign in
login.with_provider: Sign in with your identity provider
login.none_configured: No way to sign in is configured. Set admin credentials or an OIDC issuer.
noaccess.heading: You are signed in, but have no permissions
noaccess.signed_in_as: Signed in as {0}. Your account carries no Teamster role, so there is nothing here you may see or change yet.
noaccess.anonymous: Your account carries no Teamster role, so there is nothing here you may see or change yet.
noaccess.ask: Ask an administrator to grant you the viewer, editor or admin role in the identity provider, then sign in again — a role is read when you sign in.
admin.read_only: Signed in with the {0} role, which may look but not change anything.
templates.name: Name
templates.empty: No templates yet. A route needs one to render its message.
palette.starter_help: Replace the card with a complete example to edit down
destinations.empty: No destinations yet. Add the Team and channel to post into.
routes.parent_none: — nothing, this is a root route —
routes.greedy: Deliver instead of the route it refines, not as well as it
routes.empty: No routes yet. Without one, every alert is rejected.
grants.explainer: A role with no grant reaches every Team and channel. Once a grant names a role, that role reaches what its grants name and nothing else. Admins are never limited.
grants.channel: Channel ID (optional, empty grants the whole Team)
grants.empty: No grants yet, so every role reaches every Team and channel.
routing.match_heading: Which route would an alert take?
routing.graph_help: Arrows follow an alert from the webhook through the routes that match it to the channels it lands in. A dashed arrow is a child route refining its parent, labelled with whether it delivers as well as its parent or instead of it. Check a label set to highlight every path it takes. Drag a node to rearrange it, scroll to zoom.
routing.templates_heading: Which routes render with which template?
routing.templates_help: Rendering is not a step an alert takes, so it has its own picture. A template with no route beside it is used by nothing.
